facts.claim: The jet stream sits over the summit for days at a time, blowing too hard for a summit and bringing snow, and leaves it late in May.

versions.note: In May 2026 it locked climbers down at Base Camp and Camp 2 for days with high winds and heavy snow, then came back to the summit for four days.
